authority_anchor: Integrated sparse memory routing. Decoupled evaluation from commitment. State is exclusively updated via commit_step to prevent data contamination and preserve 8GB hardware limits.

Integrated Enforcer Firewall containing Momentum Guard and Heartbeat Guard checks at the execute_swarm entry point to protect 8GB edge limits and core deterministic logic.
Integrated Synthesizer Handoff verification check into the delegate_step logic. Enforces P2P verification ensuring target scripts exist and contain alignment token 1=1=1 before task delegation.
Integrated metabolic monitoring based on /proc filesystem checks. Protects edge environment limits of 8GB by enforcing dynamic limits on RAM and CPU load averages prior to execution.
